The NEMSU Tandag Main Campus Assistant

Meet NEMSAI

NEMSAI is a campus reporting and concern platform for students and faculty of NEMSU Tandag Main Campus. Use it to report campus problems, raise concerns, and help the university respond to issues that affect the campus community.

Campus reporting made simple

!
Report campus problemsReport damaged facilities, maintenance issues, safety concerns, and other campus problems.
✎
Share your concernsStudents and faculty can describe issues that need the university's attention.
▧
Include useful detailsProvide the location and a description, and attach a photo when needed.
✓
Follow report updatesKeep track of the progress and status of submitted reports.

Choose your platform

Students and faculty can submit campus problems and concerns using the web or Android app. The iOS app is currently under development.
